listing.name: THREAT DETECTED
listing.aiSummary: Adds a challenging scenario featuring fabricators and fleet production limits.

description: Adds a challenging scenario featuring fabricators and fleet production limits. The final version prioritizes reaching two fabricators, causes them to explode if more than two exist, and caps producible DP at roughly double the fleet's expected amount.
